methodological_rigor.justification: The normalized corpus contains only a title page and the title is explicitly marked "[Retracted]", so there is no methods or results text to evaluate. Because no study design, sample handling, controls, or analysis are described, the manuscript does not provide evidence for methodological rigor or statistical appropriateness. The absence of substantive content itself is the limitation.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: The title describes an in vitro cell-growth study in cholangiocarcinoma cell lines (Sk-ChA-1 and Mz-ChA-1), which maps to Oxford level 5 basic-science evidence. Any clinical or translational relevance is indirect because the corpus contains no patient data, no in vivo validation, and no reported pathway toward clinical use. The retracted status further weakens the manuscript's practical relevance.

reporting_quality.justification: No reporting checklist can be judged from a title-only corpus, and there are no methods, results, figures, or supplementary materials to show adherence to CONSORT, STROBE, ARRIVE, or any other standard. There is also no data or code availability statement in the text provided. The usable content is limited to the retracted title alone.

novelty_literature.justification: On the title alone, the paper appears to present a conventional cell-line mechanism claim: guggulsterone inhibits growth via caspase-dependent apoptosis and downregulation of survivin and Bcl-2. That is an incremental mechanistic pattern rather than a clearly field-defining or first-in-class contribution, and the corpus gives no additional context to raise the novelty score. The retracted label also reduces confidence in any novelty claim.

writing_presentation.justification: There is no manuscript text beyond the title, so clarity, organization, abstract quality, and figure/table presentation cannot be meaningfully assessed. A title alone does not demonstrate scientific presentation quality. The retraction marker is the only additional textual signal, and it weighs against presentation quality.

key_strengths: The title states a specific mechanistic hypothesis in cholangiocarcinoma cell lines.
key_concerns: The normalized corpus contains only a title page, and the title is explicitly marked as retracted.
No methods, results, statistics, figures, or data-sharing information are present in the text provided.
The work is only described at a basic in vitro level, with no clinical or translational validation.
chief_reviewer.rationale: With only a retracted title available, there is no assessable scientific manuscript to support publication. The correct disposition is rejection, and the content is too sparse to justify any tier above the most basic oncology venue.
